stem:
Kabir wants one isolated north pole from a bar magnet by snapping it in half.

What should he expect?

options.text: Each piece still has both a north and a south end.
One piece is a lone north pole with no south end.
The painted end is the only pole that exists after the snap.
The two poles can be kept apart as separate pieces.

teacher.key_rationale: Breaking a bar magnet still leaves each piece with a north and a south end.
